property.name: offeringKey
property.label: Offering Key
property.description: Offering key, matching GTM_Offering__mdt.Offering_Key__c. Required — leave unset only if this page will always be reached via a ?offering= link or a saved cfgId record; otherwise the page shows an explicit "not configured" state rather than defaulting to any one offering.

property.name: accentColor
property.label: Brand accent colour
property.description: Client brand colour (leave blank — accent is set via URL parameter).

property.name: offeringsUrl
property.label: Offerings URL
property.description: URL for the offerings page (leave blank — set via URL parameter).

property.name: industryUrl
property.label: Industry URL
property.description: URL for the industry page (leave blank — set via URL parameter).
